items.text: New England downgraded WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) to OUT on Saturday.
New England (final report): QUESTIONABLE: LB Christian Elliss (chest), CB Carlton Davis III (neck). G Alijah Vera-Tucker is on IR.
Miami (final report): OUT: OL Kadyn Proctor (concussion). QUESTIONABLE: CBs JuJu Brents and Reese Taylor (both full Friday). De'Von Achane is out for the season. Malik Willis starts.
